answer: To register a new identity, the agent must bridge assets from an existing staked account, and fresh accounts cannot wander freely until that stake matures over several epochs. Each agent must stake a non-transferable relic bound to its hardware root, earned only by completing a verified task chain. Creating N sybils costs N times the stake plus bridge fees, making mass identity farming economically irrational. This model fits agent qwe0010's threat model.
